products.name: Optoma ProScene FHDC135 All-in-One 135" Direct View LED Display
products.description:
Optoma ProScene FHDC135 All-in-One 135" Direct View LED Display

The Optoma ProScene FHDC135 is a premium 135-inch all-in-one direct view LED display engineered for immersive visual performance and seamless integration into professional environments. Featuring advanced Flip-Chip COB technology, a fine 1.56mm pixel pitch, and Full HD 1920x1080 resolution, it delivers ultra-smooth, flicker-free playback with a high 3840Hz refresh rate and a stunning 15,000:1 contrast ratio. With 700 nits of brightness and wide color gamut coverage (DCI-P3 92.42%, Rec.709 99.36%), the FHDC135 ensures vibrant, lifelike visuals ideal for signage, presentations, and hybrid meetings. Its robust aluminum-magnesium alloy cabinet houses 200 LED tiles across five columns, offering flexible installation options including wall-mount, floor stand, and motorized stand. Powered by Android 13.0 with 8GB RAM and 64GB storage, it supports smart features like Optoma Management Suite Cloud (OMSC), Display Share, and HQScene200 controller for 4K signal handling and seamless splicing. With IP65-rated front protection, hot-swappable tiles, and a powerful 120W built-in sound system, the FHDC135 combines durability, clarity, and control making it the ultimate display solution for corporate, educational, and command center applications.

Immersive Visuals with Advanced COB Technology

The Optoma ProScene FHDC135 delivers stunning 135" Full HD visuals using advanced Flip-Chip COB LED technology. With a fine 1.56mm pixel pitch and seamless surface, it ensures vivid clarity even up close. The display supports lifelike color reproduction with 92.42% DCI-P3 and 99.36% Rec.709 coverage, enhanced by 700 nits brightness and a 15,000:1 contrast ratio. It's 3840Hz refresh rate guarantees smooth, flicker-free playback ideal for signage, presentations, and high-motion content. Built for durability and performance, the COB coating protects against dust, water, and impact, making it perfect for professional environments demanding reliability and visual excellence.

Powerful Audio and Seamless Splicing

Enhance your audiovisual experience with a built-in 120W sound system featuring 30W front speakers and 15W side speakers for balanced, immersive audio. The Optoma ProScene FHDC135 supports HQScene200 controller for advanced features like image splicing, 4K signal handling, and multi-display synchronization. Create ultra-wide 32:9 setups for Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) with Front Row layout, displaying participants, content, and chat simultaneously. Customize video height, switch views, and enjoy flexible meeting configurations. Whether for presentations, broadcasts, or exhibitions, the Optoma FHDC135 Video Wall transforms any space into a dynamic, collaborative hub.
